Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was 3 November 2025. Moss's 2 Nov Coastal digest gives that date, and your 8 Dec cutover recap confirms it. I've posted this in #coastal-team.

For the tracker, your recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov, and Kwame fully took over on 22 Nov 2025. Use 3 Nov if the tracker wants the official date.
